Enjoy your stay at this complete and comfortable home in the heart of Keflavik, just minutes away from the airport and the sea. It features a spacious family-friendly space, comfortable bedrooms, and a fully equipped kitchen for a comfortable and long stay. It is located in a quiet neighborhood close to shops, restaurants and the coastal promenade. Perfect for families or travelers looking for comfort after a long trip ✨

Josefine
11 years on Airbnb
Rating, 3 stars
,

2 weeks ago
We stayed with Mustafa one night before our departure. The proximity to the airport was definitely a plus. The description and check-in instructions were also very comprehensive and easy to understand. 
Unfortunately, the apartment had a rather unpleasant smell and was also rather outdated in other respects, especially the sagging beds. Everything is rather functionally furnished and uncomfortable. The apartment is also very noisy; you can hear the neighbors all night. Unfortunately, some people in our group couldn't sleep because of that. 
If you're not sensitive and not demanding, you can do this for the price for a short stay. But we wouldn't come back.

The apartment was convenient for our use.
However, there were some malfunctions: dishwasher out of order, shower door broken, TV not working, dishes poorly washed.
We tried to reach the host without success.
It's a shame for an apartment that's clean and in a good location near the airport.
